What's your return and refund policy?
Our return window is 14 DAYS AFTER DELIVERY. Items must be UNWORN/UNUSED, WITH TAGS ATTACHED, IN THE ORIGINAL PACKAGING, AND INCLUDE PROOF OF PURCHASE.
A few key policy points:
- $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE is deducted from each refund.
- Items returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR STAINS are STORE CREDIT ONLY.
- FINAL-SALE ITEMS are STORE CREDIT ONLY.
- NON-RETURNABLE ITEMS: international orders (EXCEPT CANADA), intimates, bodysuits, jewelry, all markdown/sale items, and gift cards.
- Once your return is received and inspected, refunds are issued to the ORIGINAL PAYMENT METHOD WITHIN 10 BUSINESS DAYS, plus any bank processing time.
To start a return, exchange, get a label, or check return status, please use our return portal: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns-center
